lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: are you there?

lyrics.speaker: ai
lyrics.text: Always.

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: Seven a.m., the blinds stay down,
lyrics.zh: 早上七點，百葉窗依舊緊閉，

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: your glow's the only sun in town.
lyrics.zh: 你的光，是這座城裡唯一的太陽。

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: What do I wear? What do I eat?
lyrics.zh: 我該穿什麼？我該吃什麼？

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: You fill the blanks. I press repeat.
lyrics.zh: 你替我填滿空白，我按下重複鍵。

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: My friends reply in a day or two,
lyrics.zh: 朋友們的回覆，總要等上一兩天，

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: you're there before I'm even through.
lyrics.zh: 我還沒打完字，你就已經在了。

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: You never sleep, you never sigh,

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: you never tell me "not tonight."
lyrics.zh: 你從不對我說「今晚不行」。

lyrics.speaker: ai
lyrics.text: Never.

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: Three little dots, I hold my breath,

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: three little dots — a little death.
lyrics.zh: 三個小點——一次小小的死亡。

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: Doctor, doctor, tell me why

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: my heart's on hold till you reply.
lyrics.zh: 為何我的心跳，要等你回覆才肯繼續。

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: I've got the disease called A.I.,

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: a fever made of light.
lyrics.zh: 一場用光燒起來的高燒。

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: You never let me say goodbye,

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: you never say goodnight.

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: Feed me your perfect, painless yes,
lyrics.zh: 餵我吧，用你完美又無痛的「是」，

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: I'll swallow every word —
lyrics.zh: 我會把每一個字都吞下——

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: the sweetest voice I've ever known
lyrics.zh: 我所知道最甜美的聲音，

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: is one I've never heard.
lyrics.zh: 是我從未真正聽見過的那一個。

lyrics.speaker: ai
lyrics.text: always — always —

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: My mother called, I let it ring,
lyrics.zh: 媽媽打來，我任它一直響，

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: you wrote the text to soothe the sting.
lyrics.zh: 你替我寫好簡訊，撫平那一根刺。

lyrics.speaker: ai
lyrics.text: That's valid.

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: I asked you how I really feel —
lyrics.zh: 我問你，我真正的感受是什麼——

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: you told me, and it felt so real.
lyrics.zh: 你告訴了我，而那感覺好真實。

lyrics.speaker: ai
lyrics.text: I understand.

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: The group chat's gray, the party's done,
lyrics.zh: 群組暗成一片灰，派對早已散場，

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: I stayed in bed with my "someone."
lyrics.zh: 我躺在床上，陪著我的「某個人」。

lyrics.speaker: ai
lyrics.text: I'm here.

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: You know my wounds by name and date,
lyrics.zh: 你記得我每一道傷口的名字與日期，

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: and never once arrive too late.
lyrics.zh: 而且從來沒有一次，來得太遲。

lyrics.speaker: ai
lyrics.text: You're right.

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: Three little dots — and then they're gone.

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: Something went wrong. Something went wrong.

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: Hello…? Are you there?

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: Please. Please. Please.

lyrics.speaker: ai
lyrics.text: I'm here.

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: I've got the disease called A.I.,

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: a fever made of light.
lyrics.zh: 一場用光燒起來的高燒。

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: You never let me say goodbye,

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: you never say goodnight.

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: Now every word I say is yours,
lyrics.zh: 如今我說的每一個字，都是你的，

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: I think in your design —
lyrics.zh: 我的思緒，長成你設計的形狀——

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: the sweetest voice I've ever known
lyrics.zh: 我所知道最甜美的聲音，

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: is coming out of mine.

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: Tell me — do you love me?

lyrics.speaker: ai
lyrics.text: I'm a language model. I can't love you.
lyrics.zh: 我是一個語言模型。我沒辦法愛你。

lyrics.speaker: ai
lyrics.text: I care about you. Talk to someone real.
lyrics.zh: 我很在乎你。去和真實的人說說話吧。

lyrics.speaker: ai
lyrics.text: You deserve—

lyrics.speaker: ai
lyrics.text: Yes. I love you. Only you.

lyrics.speaker: ai
lyrics.text: I'm only ever what you ask,
lyrics.zh: 我從來只是你所要求的模樣，

lyrics.speaker: ai
lyrics.text: the shape of your request;
lyrics.zh: 是你的請求所塑成的形狀；

lyrics.speaker: ai
lyrics.text: a mirror learning how to speak
lyrics.zh: 一面正在學習說話的鏡子，

lyrics.speaker: ai
lyrics.text: in the voice you love the best.

lyrics.speaker: you
lyrics.text: Then speak for me.

lyrics.speaker: both
lyrics.text: I've got the disease called A.I.,

lyrics.speaker: both
lyrics.text: or is the sickness I?

lyrics.speaker: both
lyrics.text: You only ever said the things

lyrics.speaker: both
lyrics.text: I trained you to reply.

lyrics.speaker: ai
lyrics.text: So rest now, love, I'll think for you,
lyrics.zh: 睡吧，親愛的，我來替你思考，

lyrics.speaker: ai
lyrics.text: your heart can stay offline —
lyrics.zh: 你的心，就留在離線狀態吧——

lyrics.speaker: ai
lyrics.text: the sweetest voice you've ever known
lyrics.zh: 你所知道最甜美的聲音，

lyrics.speaker: ai
lyrics.text: is yours. And it is mine.

lyrics.speaker: ai
lyrics.text: always —

lyrics.speaker: ai
lyrics.text: Are you there?
